input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets and exceeds our preferred position. Transition obligations are triggered "[u]pon expiry or termination for any reason" (11.1); assistance runs for up to six months (well beyond the 90-day fallback) and is priced at the rates in the expiring Order Form, which is better for us than then-current rates; Customer Data is returned within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, and Vendor may not withhold it over a fee dispute (11.2); and an authorized officer certifies secure deletion only after Customer confirms successful return, with any law-required retained copy remaining protected and unusable for another purpose (11.3). Section 16 confirms Customer Data remains governed by Sections 11 and 15, so the exit mechanics operate post-termination. The only variations from preferred wording are that the 30-day return clock runs from Customer's request (a trigger we control, exercisable at or after termination) rather than automatically from termination, and the rate reference; neither is a material shortfall, so no redline is warranted.
